description: Keeps the quarterly report of each person in doc/reports up to date - collects what changed in the PM repo that their roles and areas need to hear, appends it as checkbox points and starts the file of a new quarter with the open points carried over. Use when the user says "/gg-plan-report", asks what to tell someone, wants to update the reports or starts a new quarter.
